judgments.reason: No observed case where a winner paid more than their available coins or where the three-coin commission was applied before payment to allow an over-bid to succeed. All paid amounts shown equal committed bids and coin balances never violated.

No evidence that waiting exposed sealed rival bid values while the focal player remained uncommitted. The transcript shows commitments resolving only after all three committed and sealed bids remained private.
Settlement occurred after all lots were sold, which matches the specified close condition. There is no instance of early settlement with unsold lots in the provided trace.
No catalog purchase in the transcript received a three-coin commission; the commission is only shown applied to auction winners. The evidence does not show commission applied to catalog buys.
